brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is considering cryptocurrency as a potential tool to help Israel evade economic sanctions, according to Al Jazeera English. The proposal has gained limited traction, with few parties expressing interest in the approach.

The strategy reflects Israeli concerns about potential future sanctions and their economic impact. Cryptocurrency transactions, which operate across decentralized networks, could theoretically allow financial transfers that bypass traditional banking channels subject to sanctions regimes.
dek: Prime Minister Netanyahu mulls cryptocurrency as answer to economic sanctions on Israel, but there are few buyers.
title: Netanyahu explores cryptocurrency to circumvent sanctions on Israel
